title: SKE CL2000 Pink Lemonade Prefilled Pod + Refill - 20mg
description: Pink Lemonade blends zesty Lemonade with a sweet touch of Red Berries for a lively, soda-inspired vape. The citrus adds a fizz-like tang and the berries bring gentle sweetness for an easy all-day mix. Each CL2000 replacement pack contains a 1.8ml prefilled pod and a 2.2ml refill container. Click them together, fit to your CL2000 device and enjoy consistent flavour from the mesh coil and 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid, with up to 2000 puffs per pack depending on use. To replace: remove seals, click the pod and refill together, then push the assembled unit into the device until it locks. When both sections are empty, dispose of them responsibly and fit a fresh CL2000 pod + refill.
